onboardingPages.completionCriteria: At least one sign-in method is enabled and fully configured; when email is enabled in the extension runtime, an authenticated system admin has sent a message through the site-owned email provider and confirmed it reached the inferred admin inbox.
onboardingPages.blockedState: Keep the step incomplete and show the Login readiness explanation; provider credentials remain host-owned and must be configured by the site host.

runtimeBehavior.completionStorage: Cedros extension management state owned by the host.
runtimeBehavior.completionHelper: Host onboarding helper when available; runtime target is a manifest-backed admin section.
runtimeBehavior.missingTargetFallback: Hide broken onboarding steps rather than rendering dead links.
runtimeBehavior.siteBrainRecords: Emit setup/provider records through the Wasm telemetry emit-record seam with redacted setup metadata.
